# Email Input

## Summary
A text input specialized for email addresses, reporting format validation to its caller.

## Shape
`@value`, `@onChange`, `@placeholder`, `@required` and `@disabled` are the contract. What makes
it its own component is the `@onChange` shape: it receives the value *and* an
`EmailFormatValidationError | null` alongside the event, so the consuming card decides how to
present an invalid address instead of each form re-deriving the rules. Email validation is
where hand-rolled forms diverge most, which is the reason to reach for this rather than a bare
text input.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/email-input/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { EmailInput } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
